# Topic A — R as a Calculator & Assignment


## Q1 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Store the Earth's radius (3,963 miles) and compute the circumference and the surface area, rounded to 2 decimals.

```{r q1-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
# Step 1: store values with <-
radius <- 3963
# Step 2: use the built-in constant pi
circumference <- 2 * pi * radius
area <- 4 * pi * radius^2
# Step 3: round and print
round(circumference, 2)
round(area, 2)
```

# Topic B — Vectors & Indexing


## Q6 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Store 7 daily high temperatures in a vector and summarise them.

```{r q6-data, eval=TRUE}
temps <- c(24.5, 26.1, 23.8, 27.4, 28.0, 25.2, 22.9)
days  <- c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
```

```{r q6-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
length(temps)
mean(temps)
max(temps)
days[which.max(temps)]        # the hottest day
temps > 25                    # logical vector
hot_days <- sum(temps > 25)   # TRUE counts as 1
hot_days
days[temps > 25]              # names of the hot days
```

# Topic C — Data Frames


## Q11 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Combine vectors into a data frame and inspect it.

```{r q11-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
students <- data.frame(
  name  = c("Ana", "Ben", "Chen", "Dee", "Eli", "Fay"),
  class = c("A", "B", "A", "B", "A", "B"),
  score = c(78, 85, 62, 91, 70, 88),
  hours = c(3, 5, 1, 6, 2, 4))
str(students)
summary(students$score)
mean_score <- mean(students$score)
mean_score
students[students$hours > 3, ]     # rows: more than 3 hours of study
```

# Topic D — CSV Files & Levels of Measurement


## Q16 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Read the donors data and inspect its size and variable types.

```{r q16-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
donors <- read.csv("donors.csv")   # the file must be in your working directory
n_rows <- nrow(donors)
n_rows
ncol(donors)
str(donors[, c("age", "state", "urbanicity", "incomeRating", "totalGivingAmount")])
table(donors$urbanicity)
```

## Q17 · L2 · Fill-in

**Goal:** Count the missing ages, compute the mean age without them, and the proportion of female donors.

```{r q17-l2}
n_missing <- sum(is.na(donors$___))
mean_age  <- round(mean(donors$age, na.rm = ___), 2)
prop_female <- round(mean(donors$gender == "___", na.rm = TRUE), 3)
n_missing; mean_age; prop_female
```
